items.title: 5.1.2 Role of Models in Decision-Making (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.1.2 (PDF 127, printed 124).

blocks.text: Models is liye useful (kaam ke) hain ke yeh kisi masle par sochne ka ek structured (tarteeb wala, step by step) tareeqa dete hain. Yeh complicated information (maloomat) ko aasan bana dete hain. Decision making (faisla karne) mein yeh khaas taur par aham hai, kyun ke model se hum faisle se pehle alag alag outcomes (nateeje) par soch sakte hain.

Misal: Ek kisan model istemal kar ke tay karta hai ke fasal bone ka behtareen waqt kaunsa hai. Mausam ke patterns aur mitti ki halat dekh kar model sahi waqt ka andaza lagata hai, jis se achhi fasal ka chance (imkan) barhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Asal duniya ke problems hal karne mein statistical models ka role (kirdar) aur importance (ahmiyat) samjhaiye. (Long question 1)
blocks.explanation: Statistical model purane data se batata hai ke variables aapas mein kaise jure hain, is liye naye cases ki prediction (pehle se andaza) kar sakta hai. Yeh complex situation ko tarteeb deta hai (jaise customers aur kamai, ya parhai ke ghante aur result), faisle se pehle alag alag outcomes (nateejon) ka comparison (muqabla) karne deta hai (kab bona hai, kitna stock rakhna hai), error (ghalti) naap kar batata hai ke andaza kitna pakka hai, aur naye data par check kiya jata hai ta ke faisle evidence (saboot) par hon. Istemal: weather forecasting (mausam ka andaza), financial predictions (paison ke andaze) aur scientific research. Model fair (sab ke saath barabar) hona chahiye aur privacy ka khayal rakhna chahiye.

items: Models information ko tarteeb dete hain aur faisle se pehle outcomes ka comparison karne dete hain (kisan ka bone ka waqt).
